data.gender_notes: Quillan is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'quilianus', meaning 'young warrior'. Quillan was a common name during the Middle Ages for both boys and men. The name Quillan carries the meaning “Young warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Quillan usually hope their child will grow to embody young warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Quillan total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_english.name: Quillan

data.cultural_impact: Quillan was a popular name during the Middle Ages, particularly among the knights and warriors of Christendom. The name evokes images of bravery, strength, and courage, reminding us of the heroic figures of medieval times who defended their lands and upheld the values of chivalry.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Quillan also carries a spiritual significance, reminding us of the young warriors in the biblical sense – the believers who stand firm in their faith and fight against the temptations and distractions of the world. Like the ancient warriors of Christendom, we are called to be courageous and steadfast in our walk with God, and to use our gifts and abilities to serve Him and His people. May the name Quillan inspire us to be young warriors for Christ, seeking to follow Him and spread His love and grace to others.
